page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine operating on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors utilizing the x86_64 architecture with a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. In total, the configuration provides 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory, establishing a resource ratio of 8.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no GPU acceleration hardware.

Storage and networking configurations follow a decoupled infrastructure design. The ecs.r9i.16xlarge provides no local disk storage, requiring persistence to be provisioned via external network-attached volumes. Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 28 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The 1:8 compute-to-memory ratio provides dense memory capacity suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local ephemeral storage. Primary application fits include in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, large-scale enterprise resource planning systems, and high-throughput memory-resident data analytics.
